say:1:1430227101:1.text: The kind of fish that nobles eat, you stone-brained fool!
say:1:1430227101:1.source_cn: 就是那种专门供给贵族食用的鱼！
say:1:1430227101:1.male: The kind of fish that nobles eat, you stone-brained fool!
say:1:1430227101:1.female: The kind of fish that nobles eat, you stone-brained fool!

say:2:1430227102:1.text: The type of high quality fish meat that melts right off the bone. Not this type of peasant fare for the commoners' district.
say:2:1430227102:1.source_cn: 那可是能被直接切成生鱼片的高档货，才不是这种从平民区送...
